description: This file defines the ProjectsController class, which handles API endpoints for managing projects, including creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting projects, as well as fetching project categories and secrets.

classes.name: ProjectsController
classes.description: Controller class providing REST API endpoints for project management operations.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new project and associate it with the current user.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing project by ID.

methods.name: PatchOne
methods.description: Handles PATCH request to update the 'archived' status of a project.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a list of projects with optional filters and search.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific project by ID.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a project by ID with audit logging.

methods.name: GetSecrets
methods.description: Retrieves secrets associated with a specific project.
